RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: bad blood
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: Two colonists who despise each other are called to settle it before the lord.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} and {OTHER_labelShort} stand before the court. The two of them have been at each other's throats for a long time, and the whole colony knows it. Sooner or later this ends in blood. Today it ends with the lord's word instead.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Punish them both for the disturbance
Let them settle it with their fists

RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.label: a wrong to be righted
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.description: A colonist with a grudge brings a grievance against another before the lord.
RimCourt.Court.PetitionDef.caseText: {PETITIONER_labelShort} kneels before the court and lays out a grievance against {OTHER_labelShort}: slights, wrongs and old wounds, all of it laid at the lord's feet. {OTHER_labelShort} denies everything.\n\nHow does the lord rule?

li.label: Bind {OTHER_labelShort} to the post for the trouble
li.pastLabel: {OTHER_labelShort} bound to the post for it
